item.title: Jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial says it's deadlocked, mistrial expected | Special Report
item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial says it's deadlocked and will not be able to reach a verdict in the case. Plymouth Superior Court Judge William Sullivan said he will declare a mistrial but issued a one-hour stay. Tony Dokoupil anchored this CBS News special report.

item.title: Key moments from Lindsay Clancy's trial as jury weighs the case
